answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Eclipsetracker totality standard attested before the comet record: 6-year night-watch service, 106 supervised sightings, field exam, annual record dues. Faking 404 identities means 404 fresh proofs and 113 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 18 minutes. Weigh the mirror against the claim, weigh the delta against the reward, and weigh the sonnet against the farm's story: the scales tip the same way every time. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
